issues.text: A reading of the design, for ORCH and CODE-DESIGNER (not silent): 4.5 says pages/demo.js asks «GET /api/demo/questionnaire?lang=<lang> once per load» (the look's §2 «read once per load of demo.html»), and the design names no behaviour for a language switch on the demo; the same 4.5 builds «the survey of look 8.4 and 11», and the look's 11 says «language other than ru: after the scripts run every text is in that language; no page mixes two languages». The questionnaire and the result come from the server in one language, so after a switch they can be in the new language only by asking again. Built (the reading that keeps both rules): the questionnaire is asked once per load in the page's language and, after a switch, once in the new language (with the 300 ms loading rule of state 1 and the failure block of §11 with «Повторить»); on the result the result is asked again in the new language as when it opens; the answers (option ids, the same in every language), the question shown and the scene stay. Measured live: «GET lang=ru,lang=en,lang=kk POST lang=en,lang=kk» for a pass that switches ru → en on question 3 and en → kk on the result; with no switch exactly one GET per load (passes). The design itself asks again on «Повторить» (E1), so «once per load» reads as «not per question». The other reading (strictly one GET per load) leaves the questions, the options and the result in the language of the load while the interface texts switch, against the look's 11; it is not one line to change back: show() would have to render the earlier language's questionnaire (with only the request removed, the planted control «no request after a switch» never shows question 3: show() keeps the empty panel). ORCH to rule; if the strict reading is chosen, it is a change for CODE-FIXER with its own gates.

(c) the noscript block is <noscript> > div.wrap.ask-wrap > div.ask > div.msg inside main, before #demo, so it stands where the question panel stands (F3's contract writes «<noscript> > div.ask > div.msg»; the result's loading message is shown at once (8.4 state 3); (e) during the 480 ms after an answer «Назад», «enough», the cards and their keys do nothing (the look's «a second tap during that time does nothing», widened to every action so no two views race; a body that fails to parse as JSON is demo_failed, a fetch that rejects or a body cut by the time limit demo_offline; (i) a response of an earlier request (an earlier language, a result left for a chip) is ignored by a request number;
